retainedFailures.cause: First-order integration at 5 µs is too coarse for these action-potential waveforms.
retainedFailures.correction: Production default uses 1.25 µs; retain this failure and verify 1.25→0.625→0.3125 µs without relaxing 1 mV.

retainedFailures.cause: An across-node aggregate RMS hid a1.129mV endpoint error; acceptance applies to every recorded node.
retainedFailures.correction: Restrict verified calculation to dt≤.00125ms; use per-node maxima for acceptance.

retainedFailures.cause: Original single-segment passive sections do not meet the requested refinement gates for this experiment.
retainedFailures.correction: Production default uses3 segments per passive section (311 compartments for11nodes);3→5 and5→7 are published. Original failed comparisons remain in tests.

retainedFailures.cause: Unmodified nodal MRG conductance densities are not soma physiology; enlarging the node generates spontaneous activity.
retainedFailures.correction: Original straight motor-fiber benchmark remains default. An explicitly passive synthetic soma (scale=0) is a distinct exploratory loading model; it does not repair or validate the failed active-soma model.

retainedFailures.cause: The original10µm2nA verification stimulus was subthreshold for the16µm cable; no velocity can be computed.
retainedFailures.correction: That failed no-propagation diagnostic remains; a separate declared10nA suprathreshold experiment measures conduction.

limitations: Agreement verifies implementation of stated equations, not biological prediction.
MRG is a mammalian motor-fiber model; no spiral-ganglion morphologies or channel fits are measured here.
The active enlarged-soma variant fails zero-input acceptance and remains a retained failure.
The passive soma is only a hypothetical electrical load, not an excitable spiral-ganglion cell.
Extracellular test coefficients are homogeneous analytic benchmark fields. The resolved layered tissue field has its own independent validation report.
Native mechanism compilation initially failed because NEURON requested clang++; explicitly selecting installed GCC/G++ corrected the build without editing mechanism source.
